amendmentTiming: Before any user movement/occlusion recording or candidate lock; initial static development only has been scored.
reason: Use two separate source-timed procedures so returning to the start does not cancel the displacement being verified. Both preserve first outcomes; no threshold/tracker tuning after reserved results.

cues.instruction: Keep the lighter still. Keep the camera, mat and tape fixed.
Cover the lighter completely; keep the mat corners visible.
Reveal the lighter and leave it in its original position.

occlusion.truthQualification: User-cued visibility, corroborated by private original frames. Cues alone do not certify that the user followed them; disclose any unverified action rather than fabricate labels.

cues.instruction: Hold still with the lighter metal top aligned with the tape4inch mark.
Slide slowly parallel to the tape until the same metal top aligns with8inches. Keep the lighter resting flat.
Release and keep it still at8inches.

displacement.truthQualification: User-declared alignment of the SAME feature at both marks and parallel motion; independent of predicted positions. Initial/final occluded samples refuse verification.

privacy: Private original webcam samples stay outsideGit. Publish only numeric results, hashes and camera-hidden screenshots. No automatic physical action or semantic-recognition claim.

acquisitionClockAmendment.timing: Before candidate lock/held user actions; initial static callback-time development remains preserved.
acquisitionClockAmendment.method: ImageCapture.grabFrame produces an ImageBitmap independently of video-element visibility; host monotonic time at acquisition completion. Not certified sensor exposure time.
acquisitionClockAmendment.reason: Keep source acquisition independent of switching to numeric report/privacy view. Actual runtime availability checked; image bitmaps explicitly closed.
